name: project_init
title: Initialize project fields
description: Add the pecot-status field to an existing project, rename the old suffixed workflow field to pecot-status, add the Blocked and Needs Attention options to the fields that already exist, and add the lanes to the pecot-lane field with a Lanes view. The fields pecot does not use (pecot-priority, pecot-size, and the old suffixed workflow field when pecot-status also exists) are listed in migration.pending_delete, and deleted only with confirm_delete

lanes.description: Values of the pecot-lane field: the areas of work, such as plugins, teams or services. GitHub shows them on the board, so use English names. Values already on the board are kept

confirm_delete.description: Delete the fields listed in migration.pending_delete. Their values on every item are deleted too and cannot be restored. Set it to true only after the user has approved deleting those fields

change.description: create: the field was created; update: options were added to it; unchanged: nothing to do; skip: the field was not found, pecot-lane was not created because no lanes were given, or pecot-lane is not a single select field; rename: the old pecot-workflow-<suffix> field was renamed to pecot-status; delete: the field was deleted with confirm_delete

addedOptions.description: Names of the options added to the field (empty when none)

fields.description: The pecot-status and pecot-lane fields, the Status field when its options were looked at, and the fields deleted with confirm_delete

migration.description: What was moved from the old form (omitted when the command stopped before the project config)

renamed.description: Old name of the workflow field that was renamed to pecot-status (null when none)

from.description: File name of the old project config

to.description: File name the project config was moved to

config_moved.description: The old project config file that was moved to the new name (null when none)

pending_delete.description: Fields to delete that were left because confirm_delete was not given: pecot-priority, pecot-size, and the old pecot-workflow-<suffix> field when pecot-status also exists (empty when none)

deleted.description: Fields deleted with confirm_delete (empty when none)

created.description: Whether the view was created; false when a view of that name already exists or it has to be created by hand

url.description: URL of the view (omitted when it has to be created by hand)

manual_steps.description: Steps to create the view on the board, when GitHub refused to create it (omitted otherwise)

view.description: The Lanes view, with pecot-status as the columns and pecot-lane as the groups (omitted when the board has no single select pecot-lane field)

detail.description: Full failure text: the error message and the guidance lines that follow it (failure only)

log.description: Raw output of a child process (failure only; omitted when not captured)

warnings.description: Warning messages; continuation lines of a message are indented by two spaces (omitted when there is none)
